body:
The audit remains open. The published PR head is still
`d2e9f2f2984d33073386f0267a673fb7ac6478a3`; current main remains pinned at
`990430b77a9f63548ffcb642074185f61ddb3322`.

The isolated implementation now includes the reviewed native GPU repairs,
canonical Creator initialization causes and retained scalp upload layouts.
A further Buffer repair at local commit
`919ba9b9415c06981ff5dc01d21666f49407eb3e` gives zero allocation, write
overflow and logical overrun distinct typed errors with byte/offset payloads.
Its complete focused thirteen-lens successor and independent Code, Rule and
Comment source reviews found no remaining issue in those two files. Native
checks, diagnostics and SDK causes remain unchanged. This is bounded source
acceptance, not whole-PR or compiled acceptance.

The coordinated #774/#780/#826 ownership split is recorded. The old compute
entry stored in render reflection fields is resolved by the dedicated
`ComputeReflection` contract. #780 retains the agreed body, fitting, native
hair, material and application producer families; #826 is completing the
transferred generated-compute families. No ownership permission is pending.

The generated-family pre-repair inventory covers all thirteen lenses and the
exact transferred source and affected consumers. Current local repairs cover
malformed type-envelope slicing, ordered Gather/Scatter/Stream roles and
reflected fluid dispatch. Stencil's closed neighborhood schema, flat-buffer
row/plane coordinates and checked physical/signed addressing still require
completion and successor review. The frozen fluid shader literals are
preserved by source comparison; no runtime result is inferred.

The async Metal/Scalp progress packet has received independent source review.
It awaits complete material/native dependencies and correction of the
remaining wait/fallback documentation before integration. Existing material
unit/record/error-provenance/UV overflow findings, broader native hair progress
and source/device/layout associations, canonical callers, exports and both
lockfiles remain required. They are not silently deferred.

No new implementation has been pushed and no new hosted checks requested.
Only source inspection, Git/hash bookkeeping, individual source formatting and
whitespace checks have run locally. No tests, cases, helpers or assertions
were added. The earlier hosted result applies only to the published revision.
Final complete thirteen-lens waves, independent Code/Rule/Comment reviews and
required hosted checks must all pass on the same final pushed revision.
Documented numerical, process and platform validation limits remain in force.
The PR remains draft and will not be merged by this task.
